newsitem.title: INDIA: India IPCL falls in Bombay, GDR down.
newsitem.headline: India IPCL falls in Bombay, GDR down.

text.p: Shares of Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd (IPCL) continued to fall on the Bombay bourse on Thursday as brokers and analysts analysed reasons for a lower than expected profit figure for first half of 1996/97 (April-March).
The IPCL share was quoted 4.5 rupees or 3.7 percent at 117.5 rupees in latest deals after touching a low of 117.25 rupees earlier on Thursday.
The company's GDR dropped 70 cents to $10.5 in London.
IPCL chairman K.G. Ramanathan told shareholders on Wednesday the firm expected to post a 2.2 billion rupee net profit for the first half of 1996/97 (April-March).
Brokers said this was far below the 3.0 billion net profit forecast by most petrochemical analysts.
"I guess the depreciation benefits most people expected them to get did not happen," said a broker, referring to delayed commissioning of plants by the state-run petrochemicals firm.
The IPCL chairman told shareholders that low petrochemical prices, a hike in prices of domestic naphtha and reduced customs duties affected the firm's margins.
